news.title: Alonso on ‘complete’ Brentford’s tough test
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈“完成”布伦特福德的严峻考验
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is well aware of the difficult task awaiting his Chelsea team when we play Brentford on Friday evening, and our manager has been quick to point out that our opponents carry many threats beyond the obvious. After two wins and a draw from our opening four Premier League games, the Blues sit sixth in the table at this early stage of the season. A short distance across west London, the Bees remain undefeated, one point and one place below us in the standings. Much has been made of Brentford’s prowess at set-pieces and in transitions under manager Keith Andrews, but Alonso insists there is much more to their game. That makes them a dangerous opponent, especially on home soil at the Gtech Community Stadium, as we found out in our 2-2 draw there last September. ‘They do those things very well, but they do other things, not just the transition, not just the set-pieces,’ said the Chelsea manager. ‘It's a club that have developed their project and the game very well. They are very complete in many aspects, with the ball, without the ball. ‘And playing there, you see the numbers and they have great strength playing at home, so it's going to be a big challenge. I saw the game from last year, you learn from everything, and tomorrow is going to be a big test for us.’ Of course, we carry our own threat from set-pieces, with only Brighton & Hove Albion having scored from those situations more times than the Blues so far in 2026/27. That has been helped by the addition of Austin MacPhee to Alonso’s staff as set-piece coach for this season. ‘We want to have top specialists in each area in terms of the offensive part, defensive and set-pieces, and Austin has this great experience in the Premier League,’ added Xabi. ‘He's helping us a lot and we have trained like we always do to try to prepare for the games and knowing what we are facing tomorrow.’ At this stage of the season it is too soon to tell how the chips will fall in terms of the Premier League title race and beyond, even as the picture begins to take shape at Stamford Bridge and at grounds across the country. That is very much at the front of Alonso’s mind when he considers where his team stands so far. ‘It's too early to tell. For sure, there are Arsenal, Man City, they have won all the games so far, but there are still so many games. ‘I knew, but once you live it, you realise how tough each game is, how tough it is to win in the Premier League. You can't take any game for granted. ‘You need to give your best level because you get punished whenever you are not, and we have experienced that. But I think that there will be good moments for all the teams and bad moments for all the teams.’ Hopefully Friday night’s game will be one of the good moments for Chelsea, allowing us to bring three points back across west London to Stamford Bridge.
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索很清楚周五晚上我们对阵布伦特福德时等待着他的切尔西队的艰巨任务，我们的主教练很快指出我们的对手带来了许多不明显的威胁。在我们前四场英超比赛中取得两胜一平后，蓝军在赛季初期排名积分榜第六。蜜蜂队在伦敦西部不远的地方保持不败，在积分榜上比我们低一分又一位。在主教练基思·安德鲁斯的带领下，布伦特福德在定位球和转换进攻方面的能力得到了很多人的认可，但阿隆索坚称他们的比赛还有更多的东西。这使得他们成为一个危险的对手，尤其是在主场 Gtech 社区体育场，正如我们去年 9 月在那里 2-2 战平的比赛中所发现的那样。 “他们在这些事情上做得很好，但他们也做了其他事情，不仅仅是过渡，不仅仅是定位球，”切尔西主教练说。 “这是一家将他们的项目和比赛发展得非常好的俱乐部。他们很多方面都非常全面，有球时，无球时。 “在那里比赛，你会看到数据，他们在主场比赛的实力很强，所以这将是一个巨大的挑战。我看了去年的比赛，你可以从一切中学习，明天对我们来说将是一个巨大的考验。”当然，我们也有来自定位球的威胁，2026/27赛季迄今为止，只有布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩在这些情况下进球的次数比蓝军多。奥斯汀·麦克菲 (Austin MacPhee) 作为本赛季的定位球教练加入阿隆索的团队，对此有所帮助。 “我们希望在进攻、防守和定位球等各个领域都拥有顶尖的专家，奥斯汀在英超联赛中拥有丰富的经验，”哈维补充道。 “他给了我们很多帮助，我们像往常一样进行训练，努力为比赛做好准备，并知道明天我们将面临什么。”在本赛季的这个阶段，现在判断英超冠军争夺战及以后的筹码将如何下降还为时过早，尽管情况已经在斯坦福桥和全国各地的球场上开始成形。当阿隆索考虑他的球队迄今为止的处境时，这是他最关心的问题。 “现在说还为时过早。当然，还有阿森纳、曼城，他们到目前为止已经赢得了所有比赛，但还有很多比赛。 “我知道，但一旦你经历过，你就会意识到每场比赛是多么艰难，在英超联赛中获胜是多么艰难。你不能认为任何游戏都是理所当然的。 “你需要发挥出最好的水平，因为只要你没有做到最好，你就会受到惩罚，我们经历过这种情况。但我认为对所有球队来说都会有好的时刻，也有坏的时刻。希望周五晚上的比赛对切尔西来说是美好的时刻之一，让我们能够带着三分穿越西伦敦回到斯坦福桥。

news.title: Internationals: England Women Under-20s exit World Cup
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：英格兰20岁以下女子队退出世界杯
news.body_en: England's Young Lionesses were knocked out of the Women's Under 20-World Cup with a 3-0 defeat to Nigeria in Poland. Lydia Bedford's side had progressed through a difficult group with wins over Brazil and Tanzania and a draw with Canada. The Round of 16 saw them face Nigeria, with Blues youngsters Lola Brown, Katie Cox, Chloe Sarwie and Vera Jones all named in the starting XI, and Eva Hendle an unused substitute. An early opener from Tosin Rafiu saw the Lionesses 1-0 down after eight minutes. Aston Villa's Rachel Matlby, who had been prolific throughout the tournament, missed a penalty on the half-hour mark that would have seen England draw level. There were bright moments from the Blues stars as goalscorer Mamudu was denied by an excellent recovery tackle from Sarwie in the second half, and Brown then saw her half-volleyed effort well saved by goalkeeper Christiana Uzoma. Yet it wasn't to be, and second-half strikes from Janet Akekoromowei and Mary Mamudu were enough to see Nigeria progress to the last eight.
news.body_zh: 英格兰青年狮队在波兰以 3-0 输给尼日利亚队，被淘汰出 20 岁以下女子世界杯。莉迪亚·贝德福德的球队在艰难的小组中晋级，战胜了巴西和坦桑尼亚，并战平了加拿大。 16强赛中，他们对阵尼日利亚，蓝军年轻球员洛拉·布朗、凯蒂·考克斯、克洛伊·萨维和维拉·琼斯均进入首发阵容，伊娃·亨德尔则未上场。托辛·拉菲乌 (Tosin Rafiu) 率先开场，八分钟后母狮队以 1-0 落后。阿斯顿维拉队的雷切尔·马特比在整场比赛中表现出色，但在半小时内错失了一个点球，这使得英格兰队扳平了比分。蓝军球星们也有精彩的时刻，下半场进球的马穆杜被萨尔维的一次出色的抢断挡出，随后布朗看到她的半抽射被门将克里斯蒂娜·乌佐马扑出。但事实并非如此，下半场珍妮特·阿科罗莫维和玛丽·马穆杜的进球足以让尼日利亚队晋级八强。

news.title: Alonso: We need to find the right balance and mentality
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：我们需要找到正确的平衡和心态
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is sure that his Chelsea team will find the right balance between attack and defence in time, highlighting mentality and adaptability as the keys to adding clean sheets to our free-scoring form in front of goal. There is no questioning the potent attacking threat the Blues have posed to opponents so far this season under Alonso’s leadership, having scored 18 goals across our opening six fixtures in all competitions. However, after some thrilling high-scoring victories, the goals conceded at the other end cost us two points when Hull City came from behind to secure a draw at Stamford Bridge last week. As we prepare to take on Brentford in our next game on Friday, our manager made clear it is an area he and his players are working hard on improving. ‘It's obvious that in defence we can do better,’ he said. ‘In attack, we are doing well, but we need to find the right balance between the defence and the attack to not concede that many goals. ‘It's for sure clear and I'm sure that we will do it. Everything takes time. We have had circumstances that haven't allowed us to create the stability that we want, but once we get it, I think that we will be more solid.’ Alonso also dismissed any suggestion it is an issue purely for the defenders to worry about, calling for focus in all moments from every Chelsea player at the Gtech Community Stadium tomorrow evening, so we can cope with any circumstances that can arise during the intensity of a Premier League match. ‘The defence is all the team,’ the Spaniard continued. ‘It's not just the back four or the back five, it's about the team. ‘It's how we compete, how we adapt to different moments. When we take the lead or when the game is even, we need to have the same mentality to be competing in different moments. ‘We know that in the Premier League it is very difficult to control the whole game, but to be able to adapt and to feel that awareness that is needed is very important. ‘We have had four or five weeks since we started. This is going to be the seventh game in this block. It's an important one because it's before the international break, because it's in the Premier League, because it's away against Brentford who are tough. So we will have to play a high-demand game.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索确信他的切尔西队将及时在进攻和防守之间找到适当的平衡，他强调心态和适应能力是我们在门前的自由得分状态中增加不失球的关键。毫无疑问，本赛季到目前为止，在阿隆索的带领下，蓝军对对手构成了强大的进攻威胁，在所有比赛的前六场比赛中打入了18个进球。然而，在取得了一些激动人心的高分胜利之后，上周赫尔城队后来居上，在斯坦福桥战平，但在另一端的失球让我们损失了两分。当我们准备在周五的下一场比赛中迎战布伦特福德时，我们的主教练明确表示，这是他和他的球员们正在努力改进的一个领域。 “很明显，在防守方面我们可以做得更好，”他说。 “在进攻方面，我们做得很好，但我们需要在防守和进攻之间找到适当的平衡，不要丢太多球。 ‘这肯定是明确的，我确信我们会做到这一点。一切都需要时间。我们遇到的情况不允许我们创造我们想要的稳定性，但一旦我们获得了稳定，我认为我们会更加稳固。”阿隆索也驳斥了任何关于这纯粹是后卫需要担心的问题的说法，他呼吁明天晚上在 Gtech 社区体育场的每一位切尔西球员在所有时刻都保持专注，这样我们就可以应对英超比赛激烈期间可能出现的任何情况。 “防守是球队的全部，”西班牙人继续说道。 “这不仅仅是四后卫或五后卫的问题，而是关于球队的问题。 “这就是我们竞争的方式，我们如何适应不同时刻的方式。当我们领先的时候，或者当比赛打平的时候，我们需要有同样的心态来在不同的时刻去竞争。 “我们知道在英超联赛中控制整场比赛是非常困难的，但能够适应并感受到所需要的意识非常重要。 “自从我们开始以来，我们已经有四五个星期了。这将是该区块的第七场比赛。这是一场重要的比赛，因为这是在国际比赛日之前，因为这是英超联赛，因为这是客场对阵强硬的布伦特福德。所以我们必须玩一场高需求的游戏。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Brentford
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队布伦特福德的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso confirmed that Joao Pedro and Reece James, along with the whole of his Chelsea squad, remain in contention to face Brentford going into matchday. The Blues make the short trip across west London to take on Brentford in the Premier League’s Friday night kick-off, hoping to get back to winning ways after last week’s 2-2 draw with Hull City at Stamford Bridge. There were concerns over Joao Pedro after the striker withdrew from the Brazil squad for the upcoming international break, and James as he missed the start of training on Tuesday. However, Alonso insists they have not been ruled out of our next match. ‘In terms of injuries and in terms of the squad we are having the last training session tomorrow so no-one is ruled out for us for Friday,’ he explained. ‘So I prefer to be cautious and we will wait until tomorrow to take the final decision on every player. We will see tomorrow if Joao is ready to play, it’s a possibility. ‘For Reece, it was just a decision for Tuesday and we see his development and tomorrow we will decide.’ Our manager also hinted that there is a chance that Moises Caicedo could return to the matchday squad, with the midfielder having been restricted to just a brief appearance against Brighton & Hove Albion so far this season. ‘He’s getting closer and tomorrow we will take the final decision on the team and on the squad that is coming to Brentford.’ It was a similar response when Alonso was asked in his pre-match press conference if Marco Palestra or Jordan Henderson could be fit enough to make their Chelsea debuts at the Gtech Community Stadium, underlining that he will continue to monitor his options right up until it comes to the moment to name his team on Friday. ‘Tomorrow is the final decision,' he added. 'Sorry to repeat myself, but before the players know we need to assess all the positions with the last training and tomorrow we will make the decision for the game in Brentford.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索证实若昂·佩德罗和里斯·詹姆斯以及他的切尔西全队仍然有资格在比赛日对阵布伦特福德。蓝军将短暂穿越伦敦西部，在周五晚上的英超联赛开球中迎战布伦特福德，希望在上周斯坦福桥 2-2 战平赫尔城后重回胜利轨道。若奥·佩德罗因即将到来的国际比赛日而退出巴西队，人们对这位前锋感到担忧，而詹姆斯也因错过了周二的训练开始而受到关注。然而，阿隆索坚称他们并没有被排除在我们的下一场比赛之外。 “就伤病和阵容而言，我们明天将进行最后一次训练，所以周五没有人被排除在外，”他解释道。 “所以我宁愿保持谨慎，我们会等到明天对每个球员做出最终决定。我们明天看看若奥是否准备好上场，这是有可能的。 “对于里斯来说，这只是周二的决定，我们会看到他的发展，明天我们会做出决定。”我们的主教练还暗示莫伊塞斯·凯塞多有可能重返比赛日阵容，因为本赛季到目前为止，这位中场球员只在对阵布莱顿的比赛中短暂出场。 “他越来越接近了，明天我们将对球队和前往布伦特福德的阵容做出最终决定。”当阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上被问到马尔科·帕莱斯特拉或乔丹·亨德森是否有足够的健康状况在Gtech社区体育场上演切尔西首秀时，阿隆索也做出了类似的回应，强调他将继续关注自己的选择，直到周五为他的球队命名。 “明天就是最终决定，”他补充道。 “很抱歉重复一遍，但在球员们知道之前，我们需要评估最后一次训练的所有位置，明天我们将为布伦特福德的比赛做出决定。”

news.title: Spotted at the Bridge: The biggest stars in the best seats in the house
news.title_zh: 桥上的风景：最耀眼的明星坐在场内最好的座位上
news.body_en: It’s not just on the pitch where you can find some of the world’s biggest names at Stamford Bridge, with plenty of famous faces also enjoying the great view and hospitality offered by Club Chelsea on matchdays, ensuring the home of the Blues also remains the home of the stars. We all love nothing better than taking in a game at the Bridge, getting to experience all the atmosphere and drama of a matchday in the flesh, and it seems even global celebrities aren’t immune from the pull of a big match in SW6. Explore the full range of VIP Club Chelsea matchday experiences Most recently, we saw Timothee Chalamet, award-winning star of films including Dune, Wonka and Marty Supreme – to name just a few – taking his seat in the West Stand to watch Chelsea’s Premier League fixture against Hull City at the weekend. As you would expect from someone regarded as arguably the greatest actor of his generation, only the best was good enough for Chalamet, with the unmatched view and hospitality of the Diamond Suite, which like the new-for-this-season Clubhouse provides a private matchday experience away from the crowds and prying eyes. It wasn’t the first time we have seen Chalamet enjoying a matchday at the Bridge either, as he had previously been one of the many celebrities to get a taste of the Dugout Club, Stamford Bridge’s very own NBA front-row-style experience. Situated directly behind the team benches to offer a brilliant view of the game, a unique close-up of Xabi Alonso at work, and put you right in the thick of the action on the touchline, the Dugout Club is about as near as you can get to being part of the team. Just like Chalamet, that was the seat of choice for fellow actors Gerard Butler, Cara Delevingne and Callum Turner, musician Central Cee and NBA star Jordan Poole on their visits to watch the Blues. There is also the newly renovated for 2026/27 Harris Suite, named after legendary Chelsea captain Ron Harris. That sits alongside Stamford Plaza and the West Club as Stamford Bridge's seated dining experiences, and was the luxury venue of choice for Brit and Grammy-nominated singer Noah Kahan on a matchday. While we can’t make you a global star, we can share the VIP Stamford Bridge matchday experience of the rich and famous with you, as the same Club Chelsea packages enjoyed by some of the world’s biggest celebrities are also available to any supporter. As shown by the various choices of those famous faces, Club Chelsea’s matchday portfolio caters to an array of settings and experiences, from relaxed sports bars and lounges, shared suites, private boxes and unparallelled access in the Dugout Club. Supporters can secure VIP tickets to the fixtures that matter the most to them, with Club Chelsea packages on sale now for every 2026/27 home game, starting with Bournemouth’s visit to the Bridge on Saturday 10 October. You can check out the full range of matchday experiences and book your VIP seat to take in a game with the stars here.

news.title: Brentford vs Chelsea: Key statistics and facts

news.body_en: Our build-up to Chelsea's Premier League game Brentford continues with a look at the numbers you need to know, courtesy of club statistician Paul Dutton... The Blues head into our fifth Premier League match of the season, and last before the international break, in sixth place in the table. We are five points behind the top two, Arsenal and Manchester City. Friday’s opponents Brentford are one place below and one point behind the Blues. Chelsea are looking to extend our unbeaten run in all competitions away at Brentford to ten matches (four wins, five draws) since our last defeat there in October 1938, in the old First Division. Brentford have not secured a victory in their past six home league fixtures against Chelsea, recording four draws and two defeats since their 1-0 win in October 1938. All three of their Premier League wins against the Blues have been at Stamford Bridge. After winning our last meeting with Brentford at Stamford Bridge in January, the Blues are aiming for back-to-back victories over the Bees for the first time since 2021. Our last four away meetings have ended in draws. In the corresponding fixture in September 2025, Kevin Schade gave Brentford the lead before Cole Palmer and Moises Caicedo put the Blues ahead, only for Fabio Carvalho to equalise in the third minute of stoppage time. Both of the defeats in that time have come at Arsenal. Fulham, Brighton & Hove Albion, Arsenal and Hull City all conceded their first Premier League goals of the season against Chelsea. It is the first time in the competition's history that any side has been the first to score against four different teams in a season. Chelsea have conceded two or more goals in each of our first four matches at the start of a Premier League season for the first time since 2015/16 (first five games). Our last Premier League clean sheet was against Brentford at Stamford Bridge on 17 January. Our last clean sheet on the road in the competition was at Bournemouth on 6 December. Only Brighton (five) have scored more Premier League goals from set-plays this season than Chelsea. No Premier League team’s matches have produced more goals after four matchweeks than Chelsea’s 19, comprising 10 scored and nine conceded. Brighton’s games are second with 18 goals. Cole Palmer (71) is the second Chelsea player to reach 70-plus Premier League goal involvements in his first 100 appearances for the club, after Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink (77). Morgan Rogers is the fifth different player to score or assist in each of Chelsea's first four games of a Premier League season, after Didier Drogba (2010/11), Cesc Fabregas (2014/15), Diego Costa (2014/15 and 2016/17) and Eden Hazard (2018/19). Joao Pedro leads the Premier League for goal involvements this season with six (three goals and three assists). Only Drogba (eight in 2010/11) and Diego Costa (seven) have ever had more goals and assists for Chelsea in the first four matches of a campaign in the competition. Cole Palmer made his 100th Premier League appearance against Hull last week. He is one away from scoring 50 goals in the competition for the club. Only two players have reached a half century of goals for the Blues in fewer appearances – Hasselbaink (84) and Diego Costa (85). If they play this weekend, Moises Caicedo (150 appearances), Malo Gusto (100 starts), Josh Acheampong (50 appearances) and Wesley Fofana (50 Premier League starts) will hit milestones with the Blues. news.title: A message from Chelsea’s ownership
news.title_zh: 来自切尔西管理层的消息
news.body_en: Yesterday marked an important milestone and the beginning of the next chapter for Chelsea. We thank our departing partners and are grateful for their contributions to the Club. We move forward with a shared sense of purpose, clear direction and confidence in what comes next. Our ambition is clear: to compete at the highest level, to win major trophies, and to build sustained success. Chelsea FC supporters are the heart of this Club and have been its true custodians for over 120 years. While we have the responsibility of ownership, this will always be your Club. We are committed to listening, and building a Chelsea you can be proud of, on and off the pitch. Success on the pitch will always be our first priority. That means competing to win the Premier League and other major trophies and strengthening the Club commercially so that we can invest consistently in the team. We will also maintain our focus on Chelsea’s future infrastructure – investing thoughtfully and pursuing the right long-term solutions for generations to come. We are ambitious about what Chelsea can achieve, and equally conscious of the responsibility that comes with leading this great Club. We will keep working to move Chelsea forward – together.

news.title: PGA South League report: Brighton 1-2 Chelsea Women’s Under-18s
news.title_zh: PGA 南部联赛报告：布莱顿 1-2 切尔西 18 岁以下女子队
news.body_en: Chelsea Women's Under-18s maintained their unbeaten start to the league campaign with a 2-1 victory away at Brighton. The Blues took an early lead through Chelsea N'Drin's penalty before the hosts levelled after the interval. Keira Johnson (pictured top) then struck in stoppage time to secure all three points for Leanne Champ's side. Chelsea had 60 per cent possession and created 25 attempts, with 14 on target, as we battled well against a tough Brighton side. The fixture also provided an opportunity for players returning from England Women's Under-17s activity against Finland to feature again. Chelsea made a positive start and were rewarded with the opening goal after just three minutes. Patient build-up play across the back line allowed Gabi Storey to step forward with the ball and play beyond the Brighton midfield. Rebekah Pierce flicked the ball on, allowing N'Drin to use her pace to run past the Brighton centre-backs. The Brighton goalkeeper came off her line and brought down the forward, leaving the referee no option but to point to the spot. N'Drin took responsibility and converted with power and placement across the goal. The Blues continued to work hard against a tough Brighton side, creating opportunities while managing the hosts' threat. Brighton drew level after 64 minutes when a Chelsea attempt to play into midfield was intercepted. The hosts worked the ball to a winger who had moved inside, and she beat two Chelsea players before striking powerfully from around 20 yards. Her effort dipped underneath the crossbar to bring the scores level. Chelsea responded and continued to create chances, with Sophie Leach introduced for Sadie Gregory on the hour mark and Annie Boichat replacing Tess Finn at the same time. Stevie Sinclair had also come on for captain Belle Sullivan at half-time, while Jahyma Putman replaced Carla Gardiner. The decisive moment arrived in the second minute of added time. Leach, Zoe Ciccardini and Johnson combined during the build-up before a Brighton defender stepped in to challenge Johnson. Good positioning from Elise Christian allowed Chelsea to regain possession on the left. Christian drove forward into the space in front of her and, approaching the edge of the penalty area, slipped a perfectly weighted pass through to Johnson. The midfielder finished first time with her left foot across goal to secure a dramatic late victory. Chelsea remain unbeaten in the PGA South League, with 12 points from four fixtures. The Blues have scored 20 goals and conceded just two during our opening four league matches. Chelsea now welcome Arsenal Under-21s to Kingsmeadow for our first fixture of the season at the stadium on Sunday 20 September. Kick-off is at 7.30pm and admission is free. Details of how to secure a ticket are here. Chelsea Women Under-18s (4-3-3): Freya Weeks; Elise Christian, Sadie Gregory (Sophie Leach 60), Gabi Storey, Zoe Ciccardini; Belle Sullivan (c) (Stevie Sinclair h/t), Tess Finn (Annie Boichat 60), Keira Johnson; Rebekah Pierce, Chelsea N’Drin, Carla Gardiner (Jahyma Putman h/t) Scorers: N’Drin 3 (pen), Johnson 90+2
news.body_zh: 切尔西女子18岁以下队客场2-1战胜布莱顿，保持联赛不败开局。切尔西恩德林的点球让蓝军早早取得领先，中场休息后主队扳平比分。凯拉·约翰逊（上图）随后在补时阶段进球，为莉安·钱普的球队确保全取三分。切尔西拥有 60% 的控球率，并创造了 25 次射门机会，其中 14 次射正，我们在对阵强硬的布莱顿队时表现出色。这场比赛还为从英格兰女子 17 岁以下对阵芬兰的比赛中归来的球员提供了再次上场的机会。切尔西开局积极，开场仅仅三分钟就取得了首个进球。后防线耐心的组织进攻让加比·斯托雷能够带球向前推进，突破布莱顿中场。丽贝卡·皮尔斯轻弹球，让恩德林利用她的速度跑过布莱顿中卫。布莱顿门将冲出球门线，放倒了这名前锋，裁判别无选择，只能指向点球点。恩德林承担了责任，并以力量和位置完成了进球。蓝军继续努力对抗强硬的布莱顿队，在控制主队威胁的同时创造机会。第 64 分钟，切尔西试图突入中场被拦截，布莱顿扳平比分。主队将球传给一名内切的边锋，她击败了两名切尔西球员，然后从大约 20 码处大力射门。她的射门击中了横梁，将比分扳平。切尔西做出回应并继续创造机会，在比赛进行到一小时时，索菲·利奇换下萨迪·格雷戈里，安妮·博伊查特同时换下泰丝·芬恩。半场结束时，史蒂夫·辛克莱尔也替换了队长贝尔·沙利文上场，而贾希玛·普特曼则替换了卡拉·加德纳。补时第2分钟，决定性的时刻到来了。利奇、佐伊·西卡迪尼和约翰逊在进攻中联手，随后一名布莱顿后卫上前挑战约翰逊。埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安的良好定位让切尔西重新获得了左路的控球权。克里斯蒂安向前冲入她前面的空间，接近禁区边缘时，将一脚完美的传球传给了约翰逊。这位中场球员第一次用左脚越过球门，确保了最后一场戏剧性的胜利。切尔西在 PGA 南部联赛中保持不败，四场比赛积 12 分。在我们的前四场联赛中，蓝军打进了 20 个进球，只丢了 2 个球。切尔西现在将欢迎阿森纳 21 岁以下青年队于 9 月 20 日星期日前往 Kingsmeadow 球场进行本赛季的第一场比赛。晚上 7.30 开始，免费入场。有关如何获取门票的详细信息请参见此处。切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 (4-3-3)：Freya Weeks； Elise Christian、Sadie Gregory（Sophie Leach 60）、Gabi Storey、Zoe Ciccardini； Belle Sullivan (c) (Stevie Sinclair h/t)、Tess Finn (Annie Boichat 60)、Keira Johnson；丽贝卡·皮尔斯、切尔西·恩德林、卡拉·加德纳（Jahyma Putman h/t）得分手：恩德林 3（点球）、约翰逊 90+2

news.title: Chelsea FC announces ownership transition
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部宣布所有权转移
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club today announced affiliates of Clearlake Capital Group, L.P. (“Clearlake”) will acquire the ownership interest of Todd Boehly. Hansjörg Wyss will remain an important stakeholder and partner in the ownership group. As part of the transition, Clearlake will also acquire Mark Walter’s ownership interest and therefore acquire full control of the Club. In 2022, Todd Boehly and Clearlake joined together to lead the historic acquisition of Chelsea – successfully navigating an unprecedented period of uncertainty imposed by outside political events – and Todd organised his chairmanship with an unwavering commitment to this ownership group’s fundamental belief that the supporters are at the heart of everything the Club does. The owners have worked together with the shared objective of building a sustainable foundation for long-term sporting success. Under their joint ownership, substantial investment has been made across the men's and women's senior and youth squads, Chelsea’s training facilities at Cobham, medical and player-support resources, Academy development and pathways, and the sporting and business leadership of the Club. Todd Boehly now leaves his role as Chairman with Chelsea well positioned for the next phase of development. The progress made over the past four years reflects the shared commitment of Clearlake, Boehly and the wider ownership group and the leadership, staff, coaches and players at Chelsea. Clearlake intends to continue building on the strategic course the Club is now on and realising the ambition that the ownership group has developed together. Todd Boehly said, 'It has been an honour to serve as Chairman of Chelsea Football Club. I would like to thank the many who helped secure a bright future for the Club, including the English Premier League, the coaches and players, the talented leadership and staff at Chelsea, and the legions of dedicated fans. I have valued my partnership with Clearlake and the wider ownership group, and the collective decisions and investment we have made to support the immediate and long-term success of the Club. I am confident that Chelsea is well positioned for continued success under Clearlake’s leadership.' Behdad Eghbali and José E. Feliciano, co-founders of Clearlake Capital, said, 'Todd has been an important partner throughout our ownership of Chelsea, and we thank him for his time and contribution as Chairman. He will always be a part of the Chelsea story and family. Clearlake has served as Chelsea’s majority owner since 2022, and as we move to full control our focus is to continue investing in the Club’s infrastructure, sporting performance, player development and delivering long-term success for Chelsea and the Club’s supporters.' There will be no changes to the day-to-day operations, leadership or strategy at the Club. Evercore (NYSE: EVR) is serving as lead financial advisor on the transaction, with the Evercore team led by Simon Robey. The Raine Group, BDT&MSD Partners, and BofA Securities are serving as financial advisors to Clearlake. Sidley Austin LLP is serving as legal advisor to Clearlake and the Club. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC is serving as financial advisor and Latham & Watkins LLP as lead legal advisor to the sellers, with additional advice provided to Mark Walter by Winston Taylor LLP. Macfarlanes LLP is serving as legal advisor to Hansjörg Wyss.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部今天宣布 Clearlake Capital Group, L.P.（“Clearlake”）的附属公司将收购 Todd Boehly 的所有权权益。 Hansjörg Wyss 将仍然是所有权集团的重要利益相关者和合作伙伴。作为过渡的一部分，克利尔雷克还将收购马克·沃尔特的所有权权益，从而获得俱乐部的完全控制权。 2022 年，托德·博利 (Todd Boehly) 和克利尔雷克 (Clearlake) 联手领导了对切尔西的历史性收购，成功度过了外部政治事件带来的前所未有的不确定时期，托德在担任主席期间坚定不移地致力于这个所有权集团的基本信念，即支持者是俱乐部所做一切的核心。业主们为了共同的目标而共同努力，为长期的体育成功奠定可持续的基础。在他们的共同所有权下，对男女成年队和青年队、切尔西在科巴姆的训练设施、医疗和球员支持资源、学院发展和途径以及俱乐部的体育和商业领导力进行了大量投资。托德·博利 (Todd Boehly) 现在辞去董事长职务，切尔西为下一阶段的发展做好了准备。过去四年取得的进步反映了克利尔雷克、博利和更广泛的所有权集团以及切尔西的领导层、员工、教练和球员的共同承诺。克利尔雷克打算继续推进俱乐部目前的战略方针，并实现所有权集团共同发展的雄心壮志。托德·博利表示：“担任切尔西足球俱乐部主席是我的荣幸。我要感谢许多帮助俱乐部实现光明未来的人，包括英超联赛、教练和球员、切尔西才华横溢的领导层和工作人员，以及大批忠实的球迷。我非常重视与克利尔莱克和更广泛的所有权集团的合作伙伴关系，以及我们为支持俱乐部的近期和长期成功而做出的集体决策和投资。我相信，在克利尔雷克的领导下，切尔西将继续取得成功。” Clearlake Capital 联合创始人 Behdad Eghbali 和 José E. Feliciano 表示：“托德一直是我们收购切尔西期间的重要合作伙伴，我们感谢他作为董事长所付出的时间和贡献。”他将永远是切尔西故事和家庭的一部分。自 2022 年以来，克利尔雷克一直是切尔西的大股东，随着我们全面控制切尔西，我们的重点是继续投资俱乐部的基础设施、体育表现、球员发展，并为切尔西和俱乐部的支持者带来长期成功。”俱乐部的日常运营、领导层或战略不会发生变化。 Evercore（纽约证券交易所股票代码：EVR）担任本次交易的首席财务顾问，Evercore 团队由 Simon Robey 领导。 Raine Group、BDT&MSD Partners 和美国银行证券担任 Clearlake 的财务顾问。盛德国际律师事务所 (Sidley Austin LLP) 担任 Clearlake 和俱乐部的法律顾问。高盛有限责任公司 (Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC) 担任卖方的财务顾问，瑞生国际律师事务所 (Latham & Watkins LLP) 担任卖方的首席法律顾问，温斯顿泰勒律师事务所 (Winston Taylor LLP) 向马克·沃尔特 (Mark Walter) 提供额外建议。 Macfarlanes LLP 担任 Hansjörg Wyss 的法律顾问。

news.body_en: The draw for the Carabao Cup fourth round has been made and for the first time in the competition this season, Chelsea will be on the road. The Blues defeated Luton Town and Leeds United in rounds two and three, winning a spectacular tie against our fellow Premier League side 6-3 last week. We won on our most recent trip to Anfield in this competition, back in 2018, on a night when Eden Hazard scored one of his most memorable goals in a Chelsea shirt. More recently we faced the Reds in the Carabao Cup final in both 2022 and 2024, while we beat them in the 2005 showpiece in Cardiff to win the competition for the third time. news.title: Becky Spencer recounts Jamaica's odds-defying 2023 World Cup campaign
news.title_zh: 贝基·斯宾塞 (Becky Spencer) 讲述牙买加 2023 年世界杯的艰难历程
news.body_en: Goalkeeper Becky Spencer brought a wealth of experience with her when she joined Chelsea in 2025 for her second spell with the club, and she has one story to tell in particular that is fascinating to hear. Becky is a quiet character; never one to boast about her accomplishments. But ahead of Saturday’s match with Birmingham City – a club she made almost 50 appearances for across two separate spells – she chatted with us about her against-all-odds experience with Jamaica at the 2023 Women’s World Cup. The story itself is so incredible that it has been made into a film, directed by two-time Oscar winner Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy and Trish Dalton, which premiered at DOC NYC in August. For context, Jamaica – nicknamed the Reggae Girlz – had only been to one World Cup before 2023. They failed to qualify three times and did not enter twice before reaching the tournament in France in 2019. On that occasion, they went home with no points and a minus 11 goal difference, finishing bottom of the group. At this point, it’s important to introduce Jamaican music legend Bob Marley’s daughter Cedella to the story. The Jamaica Football Federation have disbanded the women’s team twice due to funding issues: in 2008 and again in 2016. In 2014, Cedella Marley released a single to raise cash for the team and secured sponsorship through the Bob Marley Foundation. In the build-up to the 2023 World Cup, the JFF once again said they were struggling to fund the women’s team and called on the Jamaican government for support. In desperation, midfielder Havana Solaun’s mother set up a crowdfunding page called “Reggae Girlz Rise Up” to get them to the tournament. It raised $50,000. That’s where Becky takes up the story… ‘I've got quite a few career highlights to be honest,’ she says. ‘But I would say being at the World Cup with Jamaica is definitely up there. ‘I don't really talk about the story a lot. But we had to have a GoFundMe to get us to Australia and New Zealand in 2023. Jamaica is a male-dominated type of country. The money and the decisions are dominated by men, and so they put the senior boys' team ahead of us. ‘We really defied the odds by qualifying. And then when we actually got there, we had the group of death, which was Brazil, France, and then we had Panama. We drew against France in the first game; it was 0-0. Bunny (Khadija Shaw) got sent off, and she's our biggest player in the team. ‘It was a real uphill battle, but I think as a group we knew that we were going to be able to do something. We had Panama in the next game, and we knew we had to win that game to at least get three points, so we won 1-0.’ Rebecca Spencer is the first Jamaican goalkeeper to keep 3 clean sheets at the World Cup 🧼🧹🇯🇲 0 - 0 🇧🇷📸: @mr_geniuz .#ReggaeGirlz #FIFAWomensWorldCup #FIFAWWC #JAMBRA #BeyondGreatness #JFF_Football pic.twitter.com/WtDAI1JOAG With their first four points at a World Cup already in the bag, Jamaica faced Brazil in the final match of the group stage. The eyes of the world were on legendary Brazilian striker Marta, knowing she would likely be appearing in her last major tournament on the world stage. Yet it was unfavoured Jamaica who would make the headlines. Spencer earned the Player of the Match award for facing eight shots on target and keeping a clean sheet, with the 0-0 draw enough to make history for the Reggae Girlz and knock Brazil out. ‘We had Brazil in the last match, and it was one of the most gruelling games,’ she says, before going on to describe what was going on behind the scenes. ‘I don't think I've ever concentrated so much in a game before. Everyone was just going for it; we defended literally for 90 minutes. We ended up drawing 0-0. So we got out of the group and into the round of 16. ‘Some of the girls were literally surviving off Uber Eats. The hotel that we were in wasn't good. There were no protein shakes, no recovery stuff. It just shows that if you've got a really strong bond within a team, that alone can take you a long way. ‘So you can only hope that if we did have all the rest of the stuff we needed, that we would actually be able to compete properly. ‘The outpouring of pride from Jamaica was amazing, and I think we showed the nation – and other nations who are struggling as well – that you can actually do it even if you don't have the resources.’ Jamaica were narrowly beaten in their first knockout round fixture, a 1-0 defeat at the hands of Colombia. Yet the team had won hearts and minds with their incredible story, and the result is what Becky describes as 'bigger than football'. ‘It was important to send another message home to Jamaica that we can achieve big things,’ she says. ‘And even if you don't have everything, you can still make it through. That’s the biggest message. Making it totally against all odds. It was honestly amazing, and we got a lot of support around the world as well. ‘I remember getting loads of messages from people in England being like, "We're Jamaica fans now because you lot are just brilliant underdogs!" and that’s exactly what we were – total underdogs. I had never been in that position before. I was just like, “Okay, this is what it's all about." That’s why it’s one of my biggest career highlights - it almost beats winning anything, to be honest. ‘We wanted the younger generation in Jamaica to be able to see a pathway. To be able to see people playing who are like them, so they know that they can do it as well. It’s bigger than football. It's about a cultural shift as well. It really was fantastic.’ Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 门将贝基·斯宾塞 (Becky Spencer) 于 2025 年第二次加盟切尔西，带来了丰富的经验，她有一个特别引人入胜的故事要讲。贝基性格安静，性格内向。从来没有人夸耀她的成就。但在周六与伯明翰城队的比赛之前——她在两个不同的时期为该俱乐部出场近 50 场——她与我们谈论了她在 2023 年女足世界杯上随牙买加队克服一切困难的经历。这个故事本身是如此令人难以置信，以至于它被拍成电影，由两届奥斯卡奖得主沙米恩·奥贝德-奇诺伊和特里什·道尔顿执导，并于八月在纽约 DOC 首映。牙买加队——绰号“雷鬼女孩”——在2023年之前只参加过一届世界杯。他们三度未能晋级，在2019年法国世界杯之前两次没有进入世界杯。那次，他们以负11个净胜球的优势无积分回家，小组垫底。此时，有必要向牙买加音乐传奇人物鲍勃·马利的女儿塞德拉介绍这个故事。由于资金问题，牙买加足协曾两次解散女足：一次是在 2008 年，另一次是在 2016 年。2014 年，塞德拉·马利 (Cedella Marley) 发行了一首单曲为球队筹集资金，并通过鲍勃·马利基金会 (Bob Marley Foundation) 获得了赞助。在 2023 年世界杯的筹备过程中，JFF 再次表示，他们在为女队提供资金方面遇到困难，并呼吁牙买加政府提供支持。无奈之下，中场球员哈瓦那·索朗的母亲建立了一个名为“Reggae Girlz Rise Up”的众筹页面，以帮助他们参加比赛。它筹集了 50,000 美元。这就是贝基讲述这个故事的地方……“说实话，我有很多职业生涯的亮点，”她说。 “但我想说，与牙买加队一起参加世界杯绝对是一流的。 “我并没有过多谈论这个故事。但我们必须通过 GoFundMe 才能在 2023 年到达澳大利亚和新西兰。牙买加是一个男性主导的国家。金钱和决定都是由男人主导的，所以他们把高年级男子队放在了我们前面。 “我们在排位赛中确实克服了困难。当我们真正到达那里时，我们遇到了死亡之组，即巴西、法国，然后是巴拿马。首场比赛我们战平法国队；比分是0-0。 Bunny（Khadija Shaw）被罚下场，她是我们队里最重要的球员。 “这确实是一场艰苦的战斗，但我认为作为一个团队，我们知道我们能够做一些事情。我们在下一场比赛中对阵巴拿马，我们知道我们必须赢得那场比赛才能至少获得三分，所以我们以 1-0 获胜。丽贝卡·斯宾塞是第一个在世界杯上保持 3 场不失球的牙买加门将🧼🧹🇯🇲 0 - 0 🇧🇷📸：@mr_geniuz .#ReggaeGirlz #FIFAWomensWorldCup #FIFAWWC #JAMBRA #BeyondGreatness #JFF_Football pic.twitter.com/WtDAI1JOAG 牙买加队在小组赛最后一场比赛中对阵巴西队，他们已经获得了世界杯的前四分。全世界的目光都集中在巴西传奇前锋玛塔身上，因为她知道她可能会出现在世界舞台上的最后一场重大赛事中。然而，登上头条新闻的却是不受欢迎的牙买加。斯宾塞因 8 次射正并保持不失球而获得全场最佳球员奖，0-0 平局足以为雷鬼女孩队创造历史，并将巴西队淘汰出局。 “上一场比赛我们对阵的是巴西队，这是最艰苦的比赛之一，”她说道，然后继续描述幕后发生的事情。 “我认为我以前从未如此专注于一场比赛。每个人都只是为了它；我们确实防守了90分钟。最终我们0-0战平。所以我们从小组出线，进入了 16 强。“有些女孩确实靠 Uber Eats 生存。”我们住的酒店不太好。没有蛋白质奶昔，没有恢复物质。它只是表明，如果您在团队中拥有真正牢固的联系，那么仅此一点就可以让您走得更远。 “所以你只能希望，如果我们确实拥有了我们需要的所有其他东西，我们实际上就能够正常竞争。 “牙买加的自豪感令人惊叹，我认为我们向全国以及其他正在苦苦挣扎的国家表明，即使没有资源，你实际上也可以做到。” 牙买加在第一轮淘汰赛中以微弱优势被哥伦比亚队以 1-0 击败。 然而，这支球队用他们令人难以置信的故事赢得了人心，其结果被贝基描述为“比足球更伟大”。她说，“向牙买加国内传达另一个信息很重要，那就是我们可以取得伟大的成就。” “即使你没有拥有一切，你仍然可以渡过难关。这是最大的信息。完全克服一切困难。老实说，这真是太棒了，我们也在世界各地得到了很多支持。 “我记得从英格兰人那里收到了很多信息，比如‘我们现在是牙买加球迷了，因为你们都是出色的失败者！’”这正是我们的处境——彻底的失败者。我以前从未处于过这个位置。我当时想，“好吧，这就是全部内容。”这就是为什么它是我职业生涯中最大的亮点之一——说实话，它几乎胜过赢得任何胜利。 “我们希望牙买加的年轻一代能够看到一条道路。能够看到像他们一样的人在比赛，这样他们就知道他们也能做到。它比足球还要大。这也与文化转变有关。这真的太棒了。’不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.body_en: Chelsea Women face Birmingham City on Saturday lunchtime, hoping to pick up our first win at Stamford Bridge this season. After a resounding 5-0 victory away at Manchester United last weekend, Chelsea return to the Bridge to face a newly-promoted Birmingham City side. We currently sit second in the WSL standings with four points from our opening two matches. Only Manchester City, with maximum points, are above us. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Birmingham City, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Birmingham City takes place on Saturday 19 September 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 12.45pm. Tickets for this match are still available to purchase here, but if you can't join us at the Bridge, the match will be broadcast live on Sky Sports. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Birmingham City Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Birmingham lost 3-1 to Manchester City on the opening day of the season, before earning a 2-2 draw with Brighton & Hove Albion last weekend. Only a 96th-minute winner from the Seagulls stopped the newly-promoted side from taking all three points. After two matches, Chelsea have taken the most shots (60) and faced the fewest shots (9) in the WSL this season. We also rank top for duel success rate (61.2 per cent) and have attempted 21 more open play crosses than any other side, with 64. Lauren James has taken 19 shots in the 2026/27 WSL, the most ever by a player across a team's opening two games of a campaign. Our No.10 has scored or assisted in her last six league matches - the last to do so in seven straight for us was Sam Kerr in April 2022. We have won each of our last eight meetings with Birmingham City across all competitions since a 3-2 league defeat in January 2019. We haven't faced them since they were last relegated in 2022. news.body_en: Levi Colwill answers our questions to take us behind the scenes at Cobham and fill us in on life off the pitch for the Chelsea defender. Who is the first player out to training? Who do you normally have lunch with at Cobham? Probably Welbs, Morgs, Cole, Reece, Hendo. The English boys mainly. After training, what’s the first thing you do when you get home? Sit on my sofa and put the TV on, put my feet up. Who do you sit next to when travelling on away trips? I suppose it's probably just with the English boys again. Who do you sit next to in the dressing room on a matchday? Last time I was next to Morgs and Jamie Gittens. Who is the biggest joker in the squad? Who is the loudest member of the squad? Probably Wes again, to be fair. Who would you say is the most active on social media that people should follow? Romeo Lavia. Yeah, it's Lav, for sure. Who do you call or message first after a match? I probably answer my parents, because they've probably text me saying something. There’s always a message from them already when I pick up my phone after a game, so it's probably them. Which outfield player do you think would be the best goalkeeper? Probably Wesley Fofana again. I feel like he's just a bundle of energy and he'd actually enjoy it. He's a bit crazy, like goalies! Which defender or midfielder would make the best striker? What is the one thing that has surprised you the most since you've been at Chelsea? That’s hard because I was just a kid when I joined, so it's going back a long way. Probably, growing up here and that, just the level of every age group and how it improves until you get to the first team. There's always improvements being made, so you can never rest on your laurels. So every step you make, you can never think you've done it, even now.
news.body_zh: 列维·科尔威尔回答了我们的问题，带我们了解科巴姆的幕后故事，并向我们介绍这位切尔西后卫的场外生活。第一个参加训练的球员是谁？您通常在科巴姆与谁共进午餐？可能是韦尔布斯、莫格斯、科尔、里斯、亨多。主要是英国男孩。训练结束后，回到家第一件事是什么？坐在沙发上，打开电视，把脚抬起来。外出旅行时，您坐在谁旁边？我想这可能又是英国男孩们的事了。比赛日在更衣室里你坐在谁旁边？上次我旁边是莫格斯和杰米·吉滕斯。谁是队里最大的小丑？队伍中声音最大的成员是谁？公平地说，可能又是韦斯。您认为谁是人们应该关注的社交媒体上最活跃的人？罗密欧·拉维亚.是的，肯定是拉夫。比赛结束后你首先给谁打电话或发消息？我可能会回复我的父母，因为他们可能给我发短信说了些什么。当我在比赛结束后拿起手机时，总会有他们发来的消息，所以很可能是他们。您认为哪位外场球员会是最好的守门员？可能又是韦斯利·福法纳。我觉得他只是一团能量，而且他真的很享受。他有点疯狂，就像守门员一样！哪位后卫或中场球员会成为最佳前锋？自从你来到切尔西以来，最让你惊讶的一件事是什么？这很难，因为我加入时还只是个孩子，所以这已经是很久以前的事情了。也许，在这里长大，每个年龄段的水平以及在进入一线队之前如何提高。总会有进步，所以你永远不能满足于现状。所以你迈出的每一步，你永远不会认为你已经做到了，即使是现在。

news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen were beaten 2-1 by Wycombe Wanderers in the EFL Trophy, with Harrison Bettoni’s stoppage-time strike coming too late to rescue a point. The Blues had opportunities to go ahead, Bettoni curling a free-kick narrowly wide before Jashayde Greenwood twice tested Mikki van Sas early in the second half. Mohamed Keita opened the scoring for the hosts after the break, with substitute Caolan Boyd-Munce doubling their advantage late on. Bettoni reduced the deficit with a powerful finish in added time, but Harry Hudson’s side were unable to find an equaliser in our second Southern Group C fixture. Our first sight of goal came after 25 minutes when Bettoni was brought down within shooting range. He took responsibility for the free-kick himself, curling a left-footed effort just wide. Justin Osagie then threatened from a set-piece as the Blues continued to seek an opener. The defender met Lewi Richards’ corner but glanced his header wide of the left post seven minutes before the interval. Neither side could break the deadlock before half-time, leaving the contest goalless at the break. Greenwood threatened twice shortly after the restart, first driving in from the left to force a save. Two minutes later, he had our clearest opportunity yet, this time shooting with his right foot when through one-on-one, but van Sas again denied him to keep the scores level. Hudson made three changes just after the hour, introducing Calvin Diakite, Mathis Eboue and Kendry Paez for Richards, Greenwood and Isaac Badu. However, Wycombe went ahead soon afterwards. Dan Casey headed down a corner and Keita swept a left-footed finish into the bottom-right corner for his first senior goal. Sol Gordon responded with a long-range strike which van Sas palmed away low to his left. Gordon then headed wide from the centre of the box as Chelsea searched for an equaliser. Instead, the hosts extended their lead. Following Aaron Morley’s lay-off, Boyd-Munce finished low into the bottom-left corner. Paez subsequently tried his luck from distance, with van Sas gathering, before Heze Grimwade replaced Harrison McMahon. Bettoni provided a late positive in the second minute of added time, volleying a left-footed shot from the right side of the six-yard box. The Blues had no time to complete a comeback. Chelsea sit third in Southern Group C with two points from two matches. Our remaining group fixture is away to Reading on Tuesday 13 October. news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea reversed scoring fortunes with emphatic Man Utd display
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西如何凭借曼联的强势表现扭转进球命运
news.body_en: Chelsea responded in style to the disappointing 1-1 draw with Aston Villa on the opening day of the Women's Super League season by putting five goals past Manchester United away from home without reply. Against Villa, the Blues had created plenty, firing 35 shots towards the opposition's goal, with the data revealing we created an xG (Expected Goals) rating of 3.6. Yet we found the back of the net just once, and a late equaliser from the visitors meant we came away with just one point to show from such a dominant display. After the match, head coach Sonia Bompastor explained why clinical finishing is so important. 'The reality of football is that in this kind of game, we need to be two or three-nil up by half-time, and the game is over,' she said in her post-match press conference. 'Then, it's a completely different game coming into the second half because when you have two or three goals difference, you can bring players in, rotate the squad.' Her words acted as a prophecy of sorts as the Blues raced into a 2-0 lead by half-time against Manchester United thanks to goals from Sjoeke Nusken and Keira Walsh. Lauren James promptly added a third on the hour mark. True to what she explained the previous week, Bompastor made a triple substitution in the 71st minute, rotating James, Katie McCabe and Alyssa Thompson for Sandy Baltimore, Veerle Buurman and Maika Hamano, before goals from Ellie Carpenter and Lucy Bronze completed the rout. Here's a look at how we turned our fortunes around. Against Villa, we created enough chances to produce an xG rating of 3.6, but netted only once. In contrast, we produced a rating of 2.94 against Manchester United but outscored that number with five goals on the day. After the match, Wieke Kaptein explained that the Blues had been working on crossing through the week in training, and that approach certainly paid off. The stats reveal that clinical finishing made the difference against the Red Devils, as we scored five times from 25 shots on goal and 30 crosses. Against Villa, we scored once from ten more shots (35) and 11 more crosses (41), showing that quality over quantity was key to our success at the Progress With Unity Stadium. Keen to ensure we took all three points away from Manchester, Bompastor played an aggressive formation. Katie McCabe and Lucy Bronze pushed up high, leaving just Kadeisha Buchanan from the back three to stay deep and alert to the danger of counter-attacks. McCabe and Bronze supported a double-pivot midfield made up of Lexi Potter and Keira Walsh, while we went for an all-out attack with a front five of Ellie Carpenter, Kaptein, James, Nusken and Alyssa Thompson. Meanwhile, Manchester United were playing only their second match under new boss Eva Olid since parting ways with longstanding head coach Marc Skinner in the summer. Bompastor's ruthless approach gave a side attempting to implement a new style of play no choice but to retreat backwards to deal with the constant goal threats from our talented front five, as the graphic below shows. The home side were reduced to an xG of 0.20, attempting just two shots on goal and taking only four touches in our box. Our all-out attacking approach may not be the correct solution for every match, but on Sunday it worked perfectly. Not only did we secure all three points, but the performance will have undoubtedly boosted the team's confidence in the shooting department. While Kaptein was not among the scorers on Sunday, her determined performance was crucial to the win. Unselfishly working to make the attack click, the Netherlands international created the most chances of anyone during the afternoon (four), and also regained possession more than any other Chelsea player, winning the ball back on ten separate occasions. Her tenacity allowed us to keep up the relentless pressure up front, also winning three aerial duels and making 24 passes in the final third of the pitch. ‘We kept possession a little bit longer, saw where the spaces were,' Kaptein said afterwards. 'Then I think a lot of people were in front of the goal, which was really good. So every time they came across or when there was an opportunity, I think everyone was ready for it.' Usually known for her elite skills in the holding midfield role, Keira Walsh made a strong display in attack during what was her 50th appearance for Chelsea in our 5-0 win on Sunday. Scoring with a beautifully-struck effort from outside the box to put us two goals in front, Walsh also assisted James after 61 minutes and won the Player of the Match trophy for her performance. The heat map below shows how she got forward into shooting range, in particular the right-hand side of the final third. Ordinarily, if Walsh were to make forward runs like those indicated on the heat map, she would be leaving a gaping hole in front of the defence.  Yet the experienced England international was free to advance, thanks to her midfield partner and Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter. The 20-year-old had the highest pass completion rate of the entire team (91.7 per cent from 48 attempts), showing that she was careful with the ball and executed her role in the system perfectly. ‘Lexi deserves to get minutes in this team,' said Bompastor afterwards. 'She's a really good player. Sometimes it depends on the tactics, the different profiles we want to use and the different systems we are playing. But it was a good opportunity for her, and she had a good performance.' On this occasion, our head coach trusted Potter to keep the ball moving, without losing possession in dangerous areas. She did exactly that, which in turn allowed her midfield partner Walsh to have so much success in attack. Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 切尔西在女足超级联赛揭幕战中以 1-1 战平阿斯顿维拉的方式做出了令人失望的回应，他们在客场以 5 粒进球击败了曼联，但没有取得任何回应。对阵维拉的比赛中，蓝军创造了很多机会，向对手的球门射门 35 次，数据显示我们创造了 3.6 的 xG（预期进球）评分。然而我们只扳回一球，而且客队在最后时刻扳平比分，这意味着我们在如此具有统治力的表现中只得到一分。赛后，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了为什么临床终结如此重要。她在赛后新闻发布会上说，足球的现实是，在这种比赛中，我们需要在半场结束时以两比三领先，然后比赛就结束了。 “然后，进入下半场，这是一场完全不同的比赛，因为当你有两到三个净胜球的差距时，你可以引进球员，轮换阵容。”她的话就像是预言一样，凭借舍克·努斯肯和凯拉·沃尔什的进球，蓝军在半场结束时以 2-0 领先曼联。劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 立即在小时标记上添加了第三个。正如她上周所解释的那样，邦帕斯特在第 71 分钟进行了三次换人，用詹姆斯、凯蒂·麦凯布和阿丽莎·汤普森换下桑迪·巴尔的摩、维尔勒·布尔曼和麦卡·哈马诺，然后埃莉·卡彭特和露西·布朗泽的进球完成了溃败。以下是我们如何扭转命运的。对阵维拉时，我们创造了足够的机会，xG 值为 3.6，但只进了一次球。相比之下，我们对阵曼联时的评分为 2.94，但当天我们以 5 个进球超越了这一数字。赛后，维克·卡普坦解释说，蓝军在这周的训练中一直在努力，这种方法肯定得到了回报。统计数据显示，在对阵红魔的比赛中，临床终结发挥了重要作用，我们在 25 次射门和 30 次传中中打进了 5 球。对阵维拉的比赛中，我们通过 10 次射门（35 次）和 11 次传中（41 次）进球，这表明质量胜于数量是我们在进步团结体育场取得成功的关键。为了确保我们从曼彻斯特队手中拿下全部三分，邦帕斯托尔打出了侵略性的阵型。凯蒂·麦凯布（Katie McCabe）和露西·布朗兹（Lucy Bronze）向前推进，后三名球员中只剩下卡黛莎·布坎南（Kadeisha Buchanan）留在后场，警惕反击的危险。麦凯布和布朗兹支持由莱克西·波特和凯拉·沃尔什组成的双枢轴中场，而我们则由艾莉·卡彭特、卡普坦、詹姆斯、努斯肯和阿丽莎·汤普森组成的前五人全力进攻。与此同时，曼联自去年夏天与长期担任主教练的马克·斯金纳分道扬镳后，这只是新任主帅伊娃·奥利德执教下的第二场比赛。庞帕斯特的无情手段让试图实施新打法的球队别无选择，只能向后撤退，以应对来自我们才华横溢的前五名的持续进球威胁，如下图所示。主队的预期进球率降至 0.20，仅尝试两次射门，在禁区内仅触球四次。我们全力以赴的进攻方式可能不是每场比赛的正确解决方案，但周日的比赛效果非常好。我们不仅全取三分，而且这样的表现无疑增强了球队对投篮的信心。虽然卡普坦不在周日的得分手之列，但她坚定的表现对胜利至关重要。这位荷兰国脚无私地努力发动进攻，在整个下午创造了最多的机会（四次），并且也比任何其他切尔西球员都更多地重新获得控球权，十次夺回球权。她的坚韧让我们能够在前场保持无情的压力，还赢得了 3 次空中对抗，并在球场的最后三分之一区域传出 24 次传球。 “我们把控球时间延长了一点，看看哪里有空间，”卡普坦后来说。 “然后我认为很多人都在球门前，这真的很好。所以每次他们遇到或者有机会的时候，我想每个人都已经做好了准备。”凯拉·沃尔什通常以其在中场位置上的出色技术而闻名，她在周日 5-0 战胜切尔西的比赛中，在她代表切尔西出场 50 次的比赛中，在进攻中表现出色。 沃尔什在禁区外一脚漂亮的射门帮助我们取得两球领先，她还在第61分钟后助攻詹姆斯，并凭借她的表现赢得了全场最佳球员奖杯。下面的热图显示了她如何向前进入投篮范围，特别是最后三分之一的右侧。通常情况下，如果沃尔什像热图上所示那样向前跑动，她就会在防守面前留下一个大漏洞。然而，由于她的中场搭档、切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特的帮助，这位经验丰富的英格兰国脚得以自由晋级。这位20岁的球员的传球成功率是全队最高的（48次传球，成功率为91.7%），这表明她对球的小心谨慎，完美地履行了自己在体系中的角色。 “莱克西值得在这支球队中获得上场时间，”邦帕斯特赛后说道。 “她是一位非常出色的球员。有时这取决于战术、我们想要使用的不同配置文件以及我们正在玩的不同系统。但这对她来说是一个很好的机会，而且她也有很好的表现。”这次，我们的主教练相信波特能够保持球的移动，而不会在危险区域失去控球权。她正是这样做的，这反过来又让她的中场搭档沃尔什在进攻上取得了巨大的成功。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Joao Pedro explains why his connection with Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers works so well
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗解释了为什么他与科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯的关系如此密切
news.body_en: There has been no shortage of quality attacking football from the Blues so far this season. Eighteen goals scored in six games is proof of that. And it's the attacking trio of Joao Pedro, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers chiefly responsible for our dynamism in the final third. They have scored ten goals and provided ten assists between them, regularly combining to devastating effect. Joao Pedro leads the attack with Rogers to his left and Palmer his right, but the trio’s fluidity and flexibility allow them to interchange, dragging defenders out of position and creating space for others. With a goal and an assist apiece in our games against Fulham, Brighton and Hull, Joao Pedro has picked up where he left off last term. And the Brazilian appreciates that one of the reasons for his own good form is having Palmer and Rogers beside him. He has explained how the trio combines. ‘Cole can score, he can pass, he can score from free-kicks, he can do everything,’ said Joao Pedro. ‘He's a different player. That's what makes him special. I just have to be ready when he gets the ball. I need to be in the right position to make the run, because he's going to make a brilliant pass, so I have to be ready to score. Because if not, later he's going to say, "Hey, Joao, you need to give me an assist!” ‘Morgan is a very skilful player,’ added our No.9. ‘We can see he can dribble past two, three guys, and carry the ball. That's what we expect from him, and I think he has started very well. ‘With Cole, I try to always give the ball to his feet. With Morgan it’s more to the space, or to let him in a one-v-one situation. And my job is just to run, and then they’re going to find me!’ Joao Pedro says the three have built a great connection off the pitch, too, which is helping their understanding when they take to the grass. He feels the central striker position enables him to showcase his myriad of skills and ‘be more dangerous’ by spending time in the opposition box. ‘Also,’ Joao jokes, ‘imagine if I try to play as a number ten, I need to fight positions with Cole Palmer! So it’s better if I stay as a nine’ The Blues’ final assignment before the upcoming, prolonged international break – when Joao Pedro will feature for Brazil once more – takes us a short way west, to Brentford. Joao Pedro clearly has plenty of confidence in the team’s ability to find the net, so if we can improve defensively then our hopes of returning home with three points increases. ‘Everyone wants to score, and Xabi (Alonso) tells us always, it doesn't matter what happens, you just need to be focused and be connected to the game and you're going to score. ‘That's why we score many goals this season from the beginning, because I think in the front three you can create a lot. And if you create a lot, you’re going to score a lot of goals as well.’
news.body_zh: 本赛季到目前为止，蓝军并不缺乏高质量的攻势足球。六场比赛打进十八球就是证明。若昂·佩德罗、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯组成的进攻三人组为我们在进攻三区的活力发挥了主要作用。他们一共打进了十个进球并提供了十次助攻，经常结合起来产生毁灭性的效果。若昂·佩德罗带领进攻，罗杰斯在左，帕尔默在右，但这三人的流动性和灵活性使他们能够互换，将防守者拖出位置，并为其他人创造空间。若昂·佩德罗在对阵富勒姆、布莱顿和赫尔城的比赛中各进一球并贡献一次助攻，继续了上赛季的表现。巴西人意识到，他自己状态良好的原因之一就是有帕尔默和罗杰斯在他身边。他解释了三人组如何结合。 “科尔可以得分，他可以传球，他可以通过任意球得分，他可以做一切，”若昂·佩德罗说。 ‘他是一个不同的球员。这就是他的特别之处。当他拿到球时我必须做好准备。我需要处于正确的位置才能跑动，因为他会传出精彩的传球，所以我必须准备好得分。因为如果没有，稍后他会说：“嘿，若奥，你需要给我一个帮助！” “摩根是一位技术非常精湛的球员，”我们的九号补充道。 “我们可以看到他可以运球过掉两三个人，并带球。这就是我们对他的期望，我认为他的起步非常好。 “对于科尔，我总是尽量把球传到他的脚下。对于摩根来说，更多的是为了空间，或者让他处于一对一的情况下。我的工作就是跑动，然后他们就会找到我！”若昂·佩德罗说，三人在场外也建立了良好的联系，这有助于他们在草地上时的理解。他认为中锋的位置使他能够展示自己的多种技能，并通过在对方禁区呆上时间来“变得更加危险”。 “另外，”若奥开玩笑说，“想象一下，如果我尝试打十号位，我需要与科尔·帕尔默争夺位置！因此，在即将到来的长期国际比赛日之前，如果我留在蓝军的最后一场九场比赛中，那就更好了——届时若昂·佩德罗将再次为巴西队出场——带我们向西走一小段路，前往布伦特福德。若昂·佩德罗显然对球队的进球能力充满信心，所以如果我们能够提高防守，那么我们拿三分回家的希望就会增加。 “每个人都想得分，哈维（阿隆索）总是告诉我们，发生什么并不重要，你只需要集中注意力并融入比赛，你就会得分。 “这就是为什么我们这个赛季从一开始就进了很多球，因为我认为在前三名你可以创造很多东西。如果你创造了很多，你也会进很多球。”

news.title: Eidur Gudjohnsen: The ‘Blond Maradona’ Days
news.title_zh: 艾杜尔·古德约翰森：“金发马拉多纳”时代
news.body_en: On the day our Chelsea legend Eidur Gudjohnsen turns 48, we remember his time playing for us as a deep-lying creative midfielder, and a very good one at that... After Chelsea’s 3-1 away win at West Ham in January 2006, the media wanted to know how our then-manager Jose Mourinho planned to cope with the loss of Michael Essien to what looked like a nasty injury 12 minutes into the match. The Blues manager directed their attention to the man who had replaced him in the centre of our midfield, Eidur Gudjohnsen, declaring that he had resembled a ‘blond Maradona’ that afternoon. It was the headline-grabbing moment of Gudjohnsen’s deep-lying creative phase for Chelsea, but by then he had been playing there for almost a year. For all that we will remember the Icelander as one of the club’s great strikers, his spell in that more withdrawn role was a fascinating departure for one of the most versatile and technically gifted players of the modern era. Gudjohnsen’s midfield experiment began in a high-stakes game: the League Cup final, in February 2005. At half-time in Cardiff, we trailed Liverpool 1-0 and looked out of sorts. It was the first really concerning period of a season that had been largely plain sailing for us. The previous two games had ended in defeat: first to Newcastle in the FA Cup, then to Barcelona in the first leg of a Champions League last 16 tie. It finally gave the outside world the opportunity to ask questions of Chelsea – were we capable of responding to this wobble? Had our opponents worked us out? To answer that question, we have to look at the way we were playing that season. First things first, we had switched to a staggered system, with Claude Makelele sitting deeper than the rest of the midfield, giving us an immediate numerical advantage in the middle of the pitch over teams playing the typical English 4-4-2 system of the time. After starting with a diamond midfield, and achieving functional, if unspectacular success, Mourinho decided to move to a 4-3-3 system, which could become a 4-5-1 when we were on the back foot. That meant sacrificing a centre-forward and playing with wide attacking players, who could stretch the opposition by going wide and trying to find the lone striker with balls into the box, which was the aim when Didier Drogba played up top. Alternatively, those wide players could look to run beyond a deeper centre-forward and make the most of his clever touches and through balls, as they did when Gudjohnsen was chosen to lead the line. The Icelander’s eventual withdrawal into midfield was the result of several combined factors. The first was the unavoidable reality that only one of he and Drogba could play up front at any given time. Then there was the fact that the third midfield berth, alongside Frank Lampard, in advance of Makelele, was up for grabs. Tiago played there most often in 2004/05, but Geremi and Alexey Smertin also had a look-in early in the season. All of them had done a job, but there was certainly room for a more artistic option. Finally, there came a time when our opponents began to man-mark Makelele in order to stop him from picking the ball up from the back four and beginning our attacking moves. To counteract this irritation, we needed an alternative outlet in midfield who was comfortable receiving the ball facing his own goal and turning to kick-start our attacking momentum, thereby taking the onus of the now-occupied Makelele. Moving Gudjohnsen into the midfield solved all three of those situations quite nicely, completing the tactical solution that Mourinho later explained in Gianluca Vialli and Gabriele Marcotti’s book, The Italian Job. ‘Look, if I have a triangle in midfield – Claude Makelele behind and two others just in front – I will always have an advantage against a pure 4-4-2 where the central midfielders are side by side,’ he said. ‘That’s because I will always have an extra man. It starts with Makelele, who is between the lines. If nobody comes to him he can see the whole pitch and has time. If he gets closed down it means one of the two other central midfielders is open. If they are closed down and the other team’s wingers come inside to help, it means there is space now for us on the flank, either for our own wingers or for our full-backs. There is nothing a pure 4-4-2 can do to stop things.’ Armed with this insight, let’s go back to the Millennium Stadium on 27 February 2005, where you will remember we were behind to a John Arne Riise goal in the League Cup final. Sensing the need for more creativity, more attacking impetus, Mourinho made a couple of brave substitutions. He took off the functional Jiri Jarosik, who had been making up the midfield trio with Makelele and Lampard, and replacing him with scheming forward Gudjohnsen. On 74 minutes he withdrew defender William Gallas and brought on another striker, Mateja Kezman, to partner Drogba up top, meaning we appeared to be playing with three at the back and two up front in the final stages. It worked. Our pressure produced an equaliser – an own goal from Steven Gerrard at precisely the time he was rumoured to be on the verge of agreeing to join us at the end of the season – which took the game to extra time, where goals from Drogba and Kezman gave us a 3-2 win and our first trophy under the ownership of Roman Abramovich. ‘It worked quite well!’ he said of his performance. ‘It’s easy to overlook it because you don’t see my name on the scoresheet, but some of the games I’ve played without goals have been up to a very high standard, and that’s one of them. A lot of people came up to me and complimented me, not just for playing in midfield but for actually changing the game.’ Gudjohnsen had been a revelation in midfield, and he spent much of the rest of the season in there, helping to connect the defensive half of our team – the back four plus Makelele – with the attacking half – the front three plus a shuttling Lampard. ‘Me and Frankie started developing a good relationship, running off each other,’ he said in an interview in 2006. ‘I used to fill in when he went forward, and vice versa.’ He was rewarded with his first league winners’ medal to add to the League Cup success a few months earlier, shortly before we overcame the first leg deficit against Barcelona in dramatic fashion at Stamford Bridge to continue our Champions League run. ‘I enjoyed the deeper role,’ Gudjohnsen said in an interview with the Official Chelsea website in 2017. ‘We had the perfect striker to be on his own up front which was Didier. We had Makelele, we had Frank, and me in a sort of half-advanced position. I knew Frank made a lot of runs, so I had to be careful I wasn’t too advanced. It worked well. I played in the same position against Barcelona and that worked, so it was gradually becoming my position, as in “I’m a midfielder now”.’ The following season, Gudjohnsen had yet more competition for places. Hernan Crespo and Carlton Cole returned from loan spells to make it four centre-forwards vying for one spot, while Michael Essien added a new element to the midfield alongside Makelele and Lampard. Gudjohnsen was only called upon to reprise his creative role when Essien suffered that injury at West Ham in January 2006. Yet, despite his starring role in the 3-1 win at Upton Park, capped off with the most beautifully-weighted through ball for Drogba to score the clincher, Gudjohnsen soon found another new arrival vying for his spot, as Mourinho’s former Porto player, Maniche, signed on a short-term deal. It proved to be Gudjohnsen’s final season at Stamford Bridge and he started fewer league games than he had in any of his previous five with the club, beginning just 16 of our 38 Premier League matches as we successfully defended our title. That summer he moved to Barcelona, demonstrating not only his technical prowess, but also the esteem in which he was held within the game. In total he made 163 appearances for Chelsea between 2000 and 2006, scoring 78 goals and winning two league titles, the League Cup and two Community Shields. 'Not bad for a boy from a little island up north!' as he put it when that list was put to him upon his departure. Perhaps that goals tally would have been slightly higher had he spent his entire time here as a forward, but then we wouldn’t have had the memories of the ‘blond Maradona’ pulling the strings and carrying the ball between the lines.
news.body_zh: 在我们的切尔西传奇人物埃杜尔·古德约翰森 48 岁生日的那天，我们记得他作为一名后撤的创造性中场球员为我们效力的时光，而且是一位非常出色的中场球员……2006 年 1 月切尔西客场 3-1 战胜西汉姆联队后，媒体想知道我们当时的主教练何塞·穆里尼奥计划如何应对迈克尔·埃辛在比赛开始 12 分钟时因严重受伤而离场的情况。蓝军主教练将注意力转向了取代他的中场核心埃杜尔·古德约翰森，并宣称他那天下午就像“金发马拉多纳”。这是古德约翰森在切尔西的深层创造力阶段的引人​​注目的时刻，但那时他已经在那里效力了近一年。尽管我们会记住这位冰岛人是俱乐部最伟大的前锋之一，但对于现代最全能、技术最有天赋的球员之一来说，他在这个更加内向的角色中的表现是一次令人着迷的离开。古德约翰森的中场实验始于一场高风险的比赛：2005 年 2 月的联赛杯决赛。在卡迪夫的半场比赛中，我们 1-0 落后利物浦，看上去状态不佳。这是一个赛季中第一个真正令人担忧的时期，对我们来说基本上是一帆风顺的。此前两场比赛均以失败告终：先是在足总杯中输给了纽卡斯尔，然后是在欧冠16强首回合中输给了巴塞罗那。这终于让外界有机会向切尔西提出问题——我们有能力应对这种不稳定吗？我们的对手打败了我们吗？要回答这个问题，我们必须看看我们那个赛季的比赛方式。首先，我们改用了交错阵型，克劳德·马克莱莱的位置比中场其他球员更深，这让我们在中场的位置比当时采用典型英格兰 4-4-2 阵型的球队拥有直接的人数优势。在从菱形中场起步并取得功能性（尽管并不引人注目）成功之后，穆里尼奥决定转向 4-3-3 体系，当我们处于不利地位时，该体系可能会变成 4-5-1。这意味着牺牲一名中锋并与边路进攻球员一起比赛，后者可以通过向边路延伸并试图找到将球送入禁区的单前锋来拉开对手的距离，这正是迪迪埃·德罗巴踢上前场时的目标。或者，这些边路球员可以寻求超越一名更深的中锋，并充分利用他的聪明触球和直塞球，就像古德约翰森被选为前锋线时所做的那样。冰岛人最终撤回中场是多种因素综合作用的结果。第一个是不可避免的现实，即在任何特定时间，他和德罗巴中只有一个人可以踢前锋。此外，第三个中场位置与弗兰克·兰帕德并列，排在马克莱莱之前，也有待争夺。蒂亚戈 (Tiago) 最常在 2004/05 赛季在那里踢球，但格雷米 (Geremi) 和阿列克谢·斯默廷 (Alexey Smertin) 也在赛季初曾到访过那里。他们所有人都完成了工作，但肯定还有更多艺术选择的空间。最后，我们的对手开始盯防马克莱莱，以阻止他从四后卫手中接球并开始我们的进攻。为了抵消这种刺激，我们需要在中场有一个替代的出路，他可以轻松地面对自己的球门接球，然后转身启动我们的进攻势头，从而承担现在占据的马克莱莱的责任。将古德约翰森移至中场很好地解决了这三种情况，完成了穆里尼奥后来在詹卢卡·维亚利和加布里埃尔·马科蒂的著作《意大利的工作》中解释的战术解决方案。 “看，如果我在中场有一个三角——克劳德·马克莱莱在后面，另外两个人在前面——我在面对中场球员并排的纯4-4-2阵型时总是有优势，”他说。 ‘那是因为我永远都会多一个男人。这要从马克莱莱开始，他是在字里行间。如果没有人来找他，他就能看到整个球场并且有时间。如果他被封堵，就意味着另外两名中场球员之一处于空位。如果他们被逼抢，对方的边锋内切提供帮助，这意味着我们的侧翼现在有空间，无论是我们自己的边锋还是我们的边后卫。 纯粹的 4-4-2 阵型无法阻止一切。”带着这样的洞察力，让我们回到 2005 年 2 月 27 日的千禧体育场，在那里你会记得我们在联赛杯决赛中落后于约翰·阿尔内·里瑟 (John Arne Riise) 的进球。穆里尼奥意识到需要更多的创造力和更多的进攻动力，因此做出了几次勇敢的换人。他撤掉了与马克莱莱和兰帕德组成中场三人组的功能型吉里·雅罗西克，并用狡猾的前锋古德约翰森取而代之。第 74 分钟，他撤回了后卫威廉·加拉斯，并换上了另一名前锋马特贾·凯日曼，与德罗巴搭档顶上，这意味着我们在最后阶段似乎是三后卫、两名前锋。它起作用了。我们的压力造就了扳平比分的机会——史蒂文·杰拉德的乌龙球，当时有传言称他即将同意在赛季末加盟我们——这使得比赛进入加时赛，德罗巴和凯日曼的进球帮助我们以3-2获胜，也是我们在阿布拉莫维奇执教下的第一座奖杯。 “效果非常好！”他谈到自己的表现时说道。 “很容易忽视这一点，因为你在记分表上看不到我的名字，但我参加过的一些没有进球的比赛已经达到了非常高的标准，这就是其中之一。很多人都来找我，称赞我，不仅仅是因为我在中场踢球，而是因为他实际上改变了比赛。”古德约翰森在中场发挥了重要作用，他在本赛季余下的大部分时间里都在那里度过，帮助我们球队的防守半场——后卫四人加上马克莱莱——与进攻半场——前锋三人加上穿梭的兰帕德。 “我和弗兰基开始发展出良好的关系，互相追逐，”他在 2006 年的一次采访中说道。“当他前进时，我常常顶替，反之亦然。”几个月前，就在我们在斯坦福桥以戏剧性的方式克服了对巴塞罗那的首回合落后，继续我们的冠军联赛之旅之前不久，他获得了他的第一枚联赛冠军奖牌，为联赛杯的成功增添了色彩。 “我喜欢这个更深的角色，”古德约翰森在 2017 年接受切尔西官方网站采访时说道。“我们有一位完美的前锋可以独自一人在前场，那就是迪迪埃。”我们有马克莱莱​​，我们有弗兰克，而我处于半领先的位置。我知道弗兰克跑了很多次，所以我必须小心，不要太领先。效果很好。我在对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中踢过同样的位置，这很有效，所以它逐渐成为我的位置，就像“我现在是一名中场球员”一样。接下来的赛季，古德约翰森的位置竞争更加激烈。克雷斯波和卡尔顿·科尔租借回归，四名中锋争夺一个位置，而迈克尔·埃辛则与马克莱莱和兰帕德一起为中场增添了新元素。 2006年1月，当埃辛在西汉姆联队受伤时，古德约翰森才被要求重新扮演他的创造性角色。然而，尽管古德约翰森在3-1战胜厄普顿公园的比赛中扮演了主角，最后为德罗巴打进了关键的一记漂亮的直塞球，但古德约翰森很快就发现了另一位新来者来争夺他的位置，穆里尼奥的前波尔图球员马尼切签下了一份短期合同。事实证明，这是古德约翰森在斯坦福桥的最后一个赛季，他在俱乐部的前五个赛季中首发的联赛次数更少，在我们的 38 场英超联赛中只首发了 16 场，而我们成功卫冕了冠军。那年夏天，他转会到巴塞罗那，不仅展示了他的技术实力，还展示了他在比赛中受到的尊重。 2000年至2006年间，他总共为切尔西出场163次，打进78球，赢得两次联赛冠军、联赛杯冠军和两次社区盾杯冠军。 “对于一个来自北方小岛的男孩来说，这还不错！” 正如他在离开时收到这份名单时所说的那样。如果他把整个时间都在这里作为前锋的话，也许进球数会更高一些，但那样我们就不会再有“金发马拉多纳”幕后操纵、在防线之间带球的记忆了。

news.title: Morgan Rogers in good company after impressive Chelsea start
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯在切尔西令人印象深刻的开局后得到了良好的陪伴
news.body_en: With his expertly taken goal against Hull City on Saturday, Morgan Rogers became just the fifth Chelsea player to score or assist in each of our first four games of a Premier League campaign. Rogers continued his impressive start to life at the Bridge by netting early in our 2-2 draw with the Tigers. It was his third of the season already, and his first strike on home soil. Having also assisted Pedro Neto in the win over Brighton, Rogers has a goal contribution to his name in every league fixture so far. Only his Blues team-mate Joao Pedro, with whom he has already linked up so well, has registered more combined goals and assists in the Premier League this term (six). And if you include the Carabao Cup, Rogers ranks top of all Premier League players for goals and assists after setting up half of the six we scored against Leeds in midweek. The attacker’s ten chances created in the Premier League is a figure bettered by only four players so far, while he ranks third for shots taken after a ball carry. It's been a very promising start to our new signing’s time as a Blue, and this achievement puts him in good company. Here are the four other Chelsea players who have also scored or assisted in our opening four fixtures of the campaign, starting with the first to do it… Drogba scored a hat-trick on the final day of the 2009/10 season to finish as the Premier League’s top goalscorer, and he picked up where he left off when the action resumed the following August. The Ivorian netted a treble on the opening day in a 6-0 thrashing of West Bromwich Albion. We won by the same scoreline at Wigan Athletic the following weekend, with Drogba providing a hat-trick of assists on that occasion. He then scored in a 2-0 win over Stoke, set up a goal in a 3-1 victory at Upton Park and, for good measure, created two more as we continued our blistering start to the season by beating Blackpool 4-0. Like Rogers, Cesc Fabregas wasted little time showing what he was capable of having left Barcelona for Chelsea in the summer of 2014. His assist for Andre Schurrle in our opening-day triumph at Burnley ranks among our very greatest in the Premier League era, and he also set up Branislav Ivanovic’s goal that day. Fabregas was at his creative best in each of our next three games, too, assisting goals in the wins over Leicester, Everton and Swansea City that maintained our flawless start to what would ultimately be a title-winning campaign. Diego Costa was the main beneficiary of Fabregas’ talent. The striker is the only player on this list to feature twice, with his start to life at the Bridge in 2014 especially eye-catching. After scoring on his debut – in that win at Burnley – and then his first outing on home soil, against Leicester, the Spain international bagged a brace in an epic 6-3 win over Everton and went one better the next weekend, taking home the match ball as Swansea were seen off 4-2. Fabregas set up three of those seven early-season goals. Two seasons later, Diego Costa repeated the trick, scoring against West Ham, Watford and Swansea, as well as laying on a goal for Willian in a victory over Burnley at the Bridge. Before Rogers, Eden Hazard was the most recent Chelsea player to score or assist in the first four league games of the season. The brilliant Belgian achieved that feat in his final year with the Blues. He created goals in the wins against Huddersfield and Arsenal that started life under Maurizio Sarri on a high, before finding the net himself as we defeated Newcastle United and Bournemouth. In our fifth game of that campaign, Hazard scored a treble against Cardiff City – something for Rogers to aim for when we meet Brentford on Friday!
news.body_zh: 凭借周六对阵赫尔城的精彩进球，摩根·罗杰斯成为第五位在英超联赛前四场比赛中均取得进球或助攻的切尔西球员。罗杰斯在蓝桥延续了他令人印象深刻的开局，在我们2-2战平老虎队的比赛中早早进球。这已经是他本赛季的第三个进球，也是他在家乡的第一次进球。罗杰斯还协助佩德罗·内托战胜布莱顿，迄今为止，他在每场联赛中都有进球贡献。只有他的蓝军队友若奥·佩德罗（他与他已经建立了如此密切的联系）本赛季在英超联赛中的综合进球和助攻数（6个）更多。如果算上卡拉宝杯的话，罗杰斯的进球数和助攻数在所有英超球员中名列前茅，周中对阵利兹联队的六粒进球中，罗杰斯贡献了一半。这名前锋在英超联赛中创造了十次机会，到目前为止，只有四名球员能够超越他，而他在带球后的射门方面排名第三。对于我们的新援作为蓝军来说，这是一个非常有希望的开始，这一成就让他有了很好的陪伴。以下是另外四名切尔西球员，他们在本赛季的前四场比赛中也取得了进球或助攻，从第一个进球开始……德罗巴在 2009/10 赛季的最后一天上演帽子戏法，成为英超联赛的最佳射手，并在次年八月比赛恢复时继续他的工作。科特迪瓦人在揭幕战当天以 6-0 击败西布罗姆维奇的比赛中攻入三冠王。接下来的周末，我们以同样的比分战胜了维冈竞技，德罗巴在那场比赛中上演了助攻帽子戏法。随后，他在 2-0 战胜斯托克城的比赛中进球，在 3-1 战胜厄普顿公园的比赛中攻入一球，此外，他还创造了两个进球，帮助我们以 4-0 击败布莱克浦，继续本赛季的强劲开局。和罗杰斯一样，法布雷加斯在 2014 年夏天离开巴塞罗那加盟切尔西后，很快就展现了自己的能力。在我们揭幕战战胜伯恩利的比赛中，他为安德烈·许尔勒送出的助攻堪称英超时代最伟大的助攻之一，当天他还助攻了布拉尼斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇的进球。法布雷加斯在接下来的三场比赛中也都发挥了他的最佳创造力，在战胜莱斯特城、埃弗顿和斯旺西城的比赛中助攻进球，帮助我们保持了完美的开局，最终赢得了冠军。迭戈·科斯塔是法布雷加斯天赋的主要受益者。这名前锋是这份名单上唯一一位两次出场的球员，他2014年在蓝桥的开局尤其引人注目。这位西班牙国脚在对阵伯恩利的比赛中首次亮相并取得进球，随后在主场对阵莱斯特城的比赛中首次亮相，这位西班牙国脚在一场史诗般的6-3战胜埃弗顿的比赛中梅开二度，并在接下来的周末取得更好的成绩，在斯旺西以4-2落败的情况下将比赛用球带回家。法布雷加斯在赛季初的七个进球中贡献了三个。两个赛季后，迭戈·科斯塔重复了这一招，在对阵西汉姆联、沃特福德和斯旺西的比赛中进球，并在蓝桥战胜伯恩利的比赛中为威廉攻入一球。在罗杰斯之前，阿扎尔是最近在本赛季前四场联赛中进球或助攻的切尔西球员。这位才华横溢的比利时人在蓝军的最后一年实现了这一壮举。他在对阵哈德斯菲尔德和阿森纳的比赛中创造了进球，在毛里齐奥·萨里的带领下开始了他的巅峰生涯，然后在我们击败纽卡斯尔联和伯恩茅斯的比赛中亲自进球。在我们该赛季的第五场比赛中，阿扎尔在对阵卡迪夫城的比赛中攻入三冠王——这是罗杰斯在周五对阵布伦特福德时的目标！

news.body_en: The first international break of the 2026/27 season will soon be upon us, when the Chelsea players called up will compete for their countries for the first time since the 2026 FIFA World Cup. This time around, it's a bumper extended international break, as a change to the FIFA calendar has combined the September and October windows into one two-week period, starting this season. That means two consecutive weekends without domestic football, instead featuring up to four matches for each national team, running between 21 September and 6 October. You can see a full breakdown of the Chelsea players called up by their countries so far and the games they will be hoping to feature in below, which will be updated as more nations confirm their squad. All kick-offs and dates are for UK time. news.title: Bompastor on James’ new role and Potter's deserved opportunity
news.title_zh: 庞帕斯特谈詹姆斯的新角色和波特应得的机会
news.body_en: Following Chelsea Women’s brilliant 5-0 win over Manchester United, head coach Sonia Bompastor highlighted the performances of Lauren James and Lexi Potter. Bompastor made two changes to her line-up as we took the trip to Manchester looking for our first Women’s Super League win of the season, having been held to a 1-1 draw at Stamford Bridge by Aston Villa in our opening game. With Aggie Beever-Jones among the substitutes this time around, those changes saw James switching to a central striker’s role. It produced the desired results as the England international netted our third goal of a resounding victory over the Red Devils. ‘I think we all know LJ is probably not a real number nine and she likes to drop deep and have the ball,’ said Bompastor, after seeing her team pick up our first league win of the campaign in emphatic fashion. ‘So it's important when we play with LJ as a number nine to have two number tens who are in the pocket, but also making penetrating runs. That's why it's important for us to pay attention when we decide which profiles are playing around her. ‘It’s important to have this threat because I think on Sunday we could exploit the space behind the back line for United and we were quite good at doing that.’ The player who came into the line-up in place of Beever-Jones was Academy graduate Potter, the 20-year-old taking her spot in midfield for her first WSL start of the season, after impressing in the 1-0 UEFA Women’s Champions League win away at Real Sociedad. ‘I already said I am a manager who really likes to develop young players,’ Bompastor continued. ‘I want to give them the opportunity when they have the right mindset, they work hard and they have the quality. I'm always keen to do that. ‘Lexi deserves to get minutes in this team. She's a really good player. Sometimes it depends on the tactics, the different profiles we want to use and the different systems we are playing. ‘But it was a good opportunity for her and she had a good performance. That's the best thing she can do for me to keep her on the pitch.’
news.body_zh: 在切尔西女足 5-0 战胜曼联之后，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特重点介绍了劳伦·詹姆斯和莱克西·波特的表现。在我们前往曼彻斯特寻求本赛季首场女足超级联赛胜利时，邦帕斯托对她的阵容做出了两项调整，我们在首场比赛中被阿斯顿维拉在斯坦福桥以 1-1 逼平。这次由于阿吉·比弗-琼斯成为替补，这些变化让詹姆斯转为中锋的角色。英格兰国脚打进了我们对红魔的第三个进球，取得了预期的结果。 “我想我们都知道 LJ 可能不是真正的九号位，她喜欢回撤并拿球，”邦帕斯特在看到她的球队以坚定的方式赢得我们本赛季的首场联赛胜利后说道。 “因此，当我们与LJ一起打9号位时，重要的是要有两名10号位在口袋里，同时还要进行突破性的跑动。这就是为什么当我们决定哪些个人资料在她周围播放时，我们必须注意这一点很重要。 “拥有这种威胁很重要，因为我认为周日我们可以为曼联利用后防线的空间，我们很擅长做到这一点。”代替比弗-琼斯进入阵容的球员是青训球员波特，这位20岁的球员在女足欧冠客场1-0战胜皇家社会的比赛中表现出色，在本赛季首次在女足超级联赛首发中占据中场位置。 “我已经说过，我是一名真正喜欢培养年轻球员的主教练，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “当他们有正确的心态、努力工作并且有能力时，我想给他们机会。我总是热衷于这样做。 “莱克西值得在这支球队中获得上场时间。她是一位非常出色的球员。有时这取决于战术、我们想要使用的不同配置文件以及我们正在玩的不同系统。 “但这对她来说是一个很好的机会，她也有很好的表现。这是她能为我做的最好的事情，让她留在球场上。”
